---
name: Bug report
about: Something broke, looks wrong, or feels unfair
title: ""
labels: bug
assignees: ""
---

**Game version**
The version on the title screen, e.g. `0.1.26`.

**What happened**
What you saw, and what you expected to see instead.

**How to reproduce it**
1. Where you were (screen, place on the map, fight)
2. What you did
3. What happened

**Screenshot**
If it is something on screen, drop an image here.

**Playtest data (optional, but it helps a lot)**
Settings, then *Export playtest data*: attach the zip here. It holds your saves and the fight logs, so I can replay what happened.

**System**
Windows version, e.g. Windows 11.
